<source_question id="SQ01" origin="p.2" concepts="C01" difficulty="medium" type="computation">
**Find 2/3 of 9.**
<solution for="SQ01">9 ÷ 3 × 2 = 6.</solution>
<textbook_answer for="SQ01">6</textbook_answer>
</source_question>
